input.claim_text: Something happened to our house last month and there is some damage we noticed. We are not sure of the cause or how much it will cost to fix.

turns.text:
DECISION: escalate

This claim lacks essential information needed for triage: the cause of damage is unknown, the estimated amount is null, and no specific insurer is named. Per policy: an unresolvable null estimated_amount and the absence of a named insurer (which prevents retrieving excess/coverage limits) both independently require escalation to a human reviewer rather than guessing coverage, cause, or dollar figures.
